id.description: The mod's record namespace and mount name (mods/<id>): what its data/ defines is <id>:... It may not be `sage`, the game's id or a plugin's namespace.

game.description: The id of the game this mod is for; "*" or left out, any.

gameVersion.description: A range against the game's own game.json "version": ">=0.1". Left out, any.

sage.description: The engine versions the mod was made for, as game.json's "sage" is: "^0.1".

dependencies.description: Mods that must be active, loaded before this one: { "other_mod": "^1.0" } ("*" for any version).

loadAfter.description: Mod ids this one loads after, when they are there.

loadBefore.description: Mod ids this one loads before, when they are there.

incompatible.description: Mod ids that refuse this mod when one is loaded before it.

assemblies.description: A code mod's assemblies, paths inside the mod's folder ({config} is the build configuration): "bin/{config}/MyMod.dll". Trusted code, loaded with the game's full trust and not sandboxed.

kind.description: "data", or "code" for a mod that names "assemblies" (flagged "contains code" wherever mods are listed).
